name: snapYaw
meaning: bit 0 CAMR_SNAPBETA: yaw snaps to multiples of 0x400 (same path as CAMREQ_SNAP_YAW) | CamRestrict.flags as one-bit u8 fields; CameraRestriction_Init 0x4a1113 builds it from the designer properties, the camera solvers read the bits (byte and/and-1 accesses)

name: forbidPad
meaning: bit 1 CAMR_FORBIDPADCONTROL: pad yaw input ignored (also implied by a trajectory)

name: mirrorYaw
meaning: bit 2 CAMR_MIRRORBETA (MIRRORBETAINTERVAL): yaw is also allowed in the arc shifted by 0x800

name: modeRun
meaning: bit 3 CAMR_MODE_RUN (MISCFLAGS bit 2): applies in camera mode 2

name: modeFollow
meaning: bit 4 CAMR_MODE_FOLLOW (MISCFLAGS bit 0): applies in modes 0 and 0xC; activates when the Wolf is inside an influence box

name: modeRobot
meaning: bit 5 CAMR_MODE_ROBOT (MISCFLAGS bit 1): applies in mode 6; activates when the Robot is inside an influence box

name: notifyWolf
meaning: bit 6 CAMR_NOTIFY_WOLF (MISCFLAGS bit 3): on Wolf activation sends Wolf msg 0x425
